correctness.rationale: The published reduction splits the normalized symmetric problem into low and high support-parameter branches. Exact factorization makes the low branch strict and shows that the high branch can attain the sharp value only at w=2. At that endpoint the auxiliary wings degenerate and the comparison body is precisely the sharp pentagon. A separate convex-slice argument proves that any original body whose Steiner symmetrization is this pentagon already equals it. Exact rational replay verifies the factorization identities and the pentagon centroid.
